rationale: The plan fits one ~condition model to all twelve samples and correctly splits the two questions: an LRT of ~condition against ~1 for the omnibus, and named Wald contrasts (condition, treated_a, control) and (condition, treated_b, control) from the same fit, with control set as an explicit reference level and the LRT explicitly distinguished from the pairwise results. QC (blind VST, PCA on top 500, distance heatmap, library sizes, zero fractions) precedes the model with a stated no-drop/report-only policy, though it can only colour by condition since no batch column exists; the filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples, the smallest group size) is minimal and justified, and normalization stays inside the model via median-of-ratios and TMM with no pre-scaling. BH at alpha 0.05 within each contrast, ashr shrinkage justified by the treated_b vs treated_a contrast, results(alpha=0.05), and separate accounting of prefilter/independent-filtering/Cook's NAs are all correct. Enrichment was not required by the reference but is specified competently (full ranked list on the Wald statistic, human-restricted Hallmark and Reactome, 15-500 window, seed, tested-gene universe, collapsePathways) and is a defensible addition rather than an error; the report section names versions, design, thresholds, tested and significant counts, cross-contrast overlap framed as descriptive, and the n=4 and reduced-feature-space caveats.
